method.performance: Measured status=pass only; pair within identical tag/case/repeat; one warm-up excluded. No pooling across tags.
method.paired_percentage: 100 * (variant / reference - 1); positive means slower or greater memory/CPU use. Median and full observed range reported.
method.numerical: Measured pass/pass; double-paired comparison plus every measured repeat pair. con and dep are separate. All uses both types.
method.payload_equality: Equal saved SHA256 payload hashes are accepted as byte equality; differing payloads are re-hashed and decoded as float32.
method.repeat_denominator: Earlier measured repeat is the reference; warm-up is never a repeat reference.
method.cpu: Kernel plus user process CPU seconds from GetProcessTimes.
method.memory: PeakPagefileUsage process commit and PeakWorkingSetSize divided by 2^20.
method.uncertainty: Descriptive medians and full observed ranges; no confidence interval or significance claim.
